title: GOOSE state and control fields
purpose: Exercise the standalone GOOSE parser path with the documented EtherType, APDU wrapper, control-block reference, state number, and ndsCom field.

messages.label: IEC 61850 GOOSE APDU with gocbRef, stNum, and ndsCom

expected_behavior: The receiver should identify EtherType 0x88B8 and decode the GOOSE APDU outer tag 0x61 with gocbRef, stNum, and ndsCom fields whose lengths match their contents.
constraints_preserved: Field tag 0x80 is used for gocbRef.
Field tag 0x85 is used for stNum.
Field tag 0x89 is used for ndsCom.
The APDU length is 0x0a and matches the ten bytes following the outer tag.
Each nested field length matches its encoded value.
issue_safety_notes: No issue evidence is supplied and no historical payload is reproduced; this is a distinct standalone frame analogue.
